entities.name: Query glycyl-tRNA ligase alpha
observations: 290 aa cytosolic protein with exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt C0R0J6.
Annotated as the alpha subunit of glycyl-tRNA ligase (EC 6.1.1.14).
Contains the tRNA-synt_2e domain, Pfam PF02091.21, spanning residues 3–280.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 33,450.5 Da and theoretical pI is 5.03.

entities.name: Glycyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: tRNA(Gly) + glycine + ATP → glycyl-tRNA(Gly) + AMP + diphosphate.
Reaction is assigned EC 6.1.1.14 and Rhea RHEA:16013.
This is a two-step aminoacylation chemistry: glycine is adenylated, then transferred to the 3′ end of glycyl-tRNA(Gly).

entities.name: Glycine
observations: Amino-acid substrate incorporated into glycyl-tRNA(Gly) during the ATP-dependent aminoacylation reaction.

entities.name: C0R0J6 glycyl-tRNA ligase alpha
observations: Reviewed Brachyspira hyodysenteriae reference protein; exact sequence hash match to the query; cytosolic; annotated with ATP binding, glycyl-tRNA ligase activity, and glycyl-tRNA aminoacylation.
